resumos: Model Control Protocol specification and tooling that lets AI agents invoke functions, such as CouchDB queries, as services.
Client libraries for the Model Context Protocol enabling agents to communicate with external services.
Os agentes que consomem servidores MCP; Claude Code, GitHub Copilot e OpenAI Codex suportam configuração de servidores via arquivo de configuração para expor busca como ferramenta.
Eine Bibliothek, um MCP-Anfragen an den Server zu stellen und Ergebnisse zu verarbeiten.
